objective: Phase H: Persistent Supabase PostgreSQL storage and Supabase Storage for KnoTrail without breaking frontend, API contracts, AI extraction, evidence verification, human review, conflict resolution, or handover workflows.
acceptance_criteria: Canonical JSONB workspace-state schema in PostgreSQL with optimistic concurrency control via integer version and save_workspace_state RPC
Dedicated handover_shares table storing only cryptographic SHA-256 hashes of share tokens with O(1) lookup and instant revocation
Private Supabase Storage bucket (knotrail-source-files) storing uploaded PDF, TXT, and Markdown files under workspace-scoped relative paths (<workspaceId>/<sourceId>.<ext>)
Server-side reusable Supabase client respecting SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY, with legacy SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY fallback, never exposed to client bundles
SupabaseStorageRepository implementing the complete StorageRepository interface with 100% method and feature parity
Storage factory dynamically routing to SupabaseStorageRepository or DurableFileRepository based on STORAGE_BACKEND env var
Fail-fast configuration validation: missing credentials when STORAGE_BACKEND=supabase throws clear server errors rather than silent local fallback
Workspace capability isolation enforcing cryptographic unguessability and strict validation (^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{3,64}$)
Clean workspace guarantee: New workspaces initialize without fake demo records, stakeholders, or synthetic findings
Deterministic automated test suite with mock Supabase adapter covering all 17+ scenarios in npm test without requiring live credentials
All 109 existing automated tests continue to pass cleanly without regression
Next.js production build (npm run build) compiles with 0 TypeScript/lint errors across all routes
non_goals: Do not add Supabase Auth or require user login, registration, or accounts
Do not break the zero-auth public demo journey or Incognito browser accessibility
Do not expose credentials or database passwords in API responses, client bundles, or logs
Do not execute remote migrations automatically against unknown databases
Do not silently fall back to ephemeral disk storage in production when Supabase is configured

verification.result: 128 of 128 automated tests passed across all 8 test suites (Phase A: 8 tests, Phase B: 9 tests, Phase C: 13 tests, Phase D: 15 tests, Phase E: 23 tests, Phase F: 16 tests, Phase G: 21 tests, Phase H Supabase: 18 tests). Next.js production build compiles cleanly with zero TypeScript errors across all 23 routes. Supabase integration thoroughly tested with mock adapter for optimistic concurrency, private Storage upload/cleanup, SHA-256 hashed share tokens, full StorageRepository parity, and fail-fast configuration checks.
